sections.text:
Phase 3a: persist UTXO snapshot to redb (issue #6)
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/9

Phase 3a per issue #6: persist the UTXO set to redb so node startup can
skip full chain replay. Closes the design discussion's two gaps (snapshot
integrity walk + crash-safe migration markers) and ships the API cascade
(single mutation log → in-memory + on-disk consumers).

**Reviewer sign-off thread**: issue #6 #issuecomment-4494274071 →
follow-up #issuecomment-4496110085 ("Ship 3a per this spec.").

## Headline: A/B numbers on the live chain (h=463,041, fly performance-2x)

| Path | Wall time |
|---|---:|
| **Today's open cost** (Exp2: full UTXO rebuild via the assume-valid-aware replay path) | **34.74 s** |
| **Phase 3a open** (modeled: Exp1 cheap structural walk + Exp4 read-side UTXO load + state_root cross-check) | **32.25 s** |
| Speedup (this chain) | **1.08×** |
| Phase 3a one-time migration cost (Exp4 finalize, paid only on the first boot after upgrade) | 1.28 s |

The 8% headline is **modest on this chain by design**: exfer's live chain
currently has near-zero non-coinbase tx activity (115k inputs across 463k
blocks → ~0.25 inputs per block on average), so Exp2 is already dominated
by per-block SMT updates, and Phase 3a also pays the SMT rebuild cost
during the UTXOS_TABLE load. Where Phase 3a actually wins:

- **Decoupling open cost from chain tx-activity.** Exp2's per-block cost
  scales with the number of inputs/outputs in each block (the apply path
  walks every tx); Phase 3a's per-block cost is fixed at "header + linkage
  + structural check". On a busier chain the gap widens.
- **Crash-safety boundary.** Today's "open = full replay" means any
  interrupted boot redoes the whole walk; Phase 3a's atomic
  `utxo_snapshot_complete` marker means an interrupted backfill just
  replays again on next boot, no inconsistent intermediate state.
- **3b runway.** Reserves `SMT_NODES_TABLE` so the future SMT-persist work
  is a localized add, not a refactor (per issue #6 Q3 + bench Exp3
  threshold math).

Bench code: `src/bin/bench_phase3a.rs` (gated behind `bench-diagnostics`
feature, default build excludes it; rebuild + run with
`cargo build --release --features bench-diagnostics --bin bench_phase3a`).

## Honest framing (per reviewer caveat)

The new boot walk is **not** "header-only". It loads every block body and
runs full structural validation (`validate_block_header_skip_pow`: block
size, coinbase structure, tx_root merkle, intra-block duplicate /
double-spend) — it just skips per-tx signature / script validation and
UTXO state mutation (both replaced by the persisted-snapshot state_root
cross-check). Boot cost still scales linearly with chain length × per-block-
structural-work; only the per-tx work is dropped.
